MALLCOM STORY

Mallcom is India’s leading Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) brand with a global footprint. Present in more than 50 countries across 6 continents, we are a valued partner for major organisations and importers.

With four decades of experience, we have established ourself as a key player in the Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) industry as an integrated manufacturer and distributor of innovative protective equipment.

MALLCOM: PROTECTING WORKERS FROM HEAD TO TOE SINCE 1983

Mallcom India Ltd. is a pioneer in Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). We specialise in manufacturing, exporting and distributing a wide range of head-to-toe Personal Protective Equipment, offering globally certified safety helmets, safety gloves, customised workwear, garments and safety shoes, all tailored for industrial hazards. From construction zones to chemical plants, our mission is to safeguard frontline workers with robust, compliant, certified industrial PPE solutions.

Mallcom is present across 50 + nations worldwide. Through the years, our innovative products have made us the leader in industrial Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Our Products offer the ultimate PPE solution, combining cutting-edge technology with ergonomic designs.

Head Protection PPE:

Our Head protection PPE range consists of certified comprehensive head protection covering the eye, ear and face. Mallcom works in close coordination with designers and users to provide dynamic head protection gear to protect workers from Industrial and occupational hazards. Which includes safety helmets, FFP1& FFP2 face masks, bump caps and safety eyewear and earplugs.

Hand protection PPE:

Our hand protection PPR range covers a wide range of applications from driving, welding, to cut resistance.From durable leather gloves, knit gloves, and resilient nitrile supported/NBR gloves, which are available in both cut and stitch and seamless designs. Engineered for optimal protection and performance, our hand protection safety gloves are designed to meet the diverse needs of diverse workforce.

Body protection PPE:

Mallcom excels in providing top-quality body protection PPE through Mallcom workwear. Crafted for comprehensive protection in Industrial settings, these garments offer durability and comfort during extended wear. From light-weight to heavy-duty industrial work, high visibility workwear, winter protection uniforms, and corporate casual wear. These PPE provide top-notch protection and are used in sectors such as hospitality, healthcare, HORECA and general industrial purposes. The special fabric is custom-made and it protects the wearer in environments such as heat, fire, and extremely cold temperatures.

Feet Protection PPE:

Pioneering the manufacturing of direct-injected Polyurethane safety footwear, Mallcom produces sturdy industrial safety shoes that can tackle challenges in construction, mining, metallurgical, oil and gas, iron and steel, heavy engineering and other manufacturing industries. Our range of safety shoes also provides foot protection in industries such as pharmaceutical, hospitality, logistics, repairs, and maintenance.
